blocks.title: NPC tab light
blocks.about: Solid white runs, tinted by the component.

fonts.about: The 5 px letters of the NPC dialogue's hints, page count and answer numbers: text whose capitals' top stands b rows above the screen's bottom takes shift 72 minus b. SmallFont holds their advances.

blocks.title: The five-pixel letters
blocks.about: Capitals 5 rows high under a row for the umlauts' dots, lower case and a descender row, padded below by one row.

fonts.about: An NPC's name plate in the world, a pill: its top 2 rows below the text row, its name and icon in the ui text font 3 rows below its top.

lists.about: The pill, white for the NPC's colour to tint: its left end, its right end and middles of 1 to 128 columns.
The light row under a pill's top, runs of 1 to 128 columns.

blocks.title: NPC pill plate
blocks.about: A 13 high round box, white with an outline at 20 %, which the text colour tints.

blocks.title: NPC plate light row
blocks.about: White runs on one row, tinted by the component.

blocks.title: NPC plate marks
blocks.about: The speech bubble over a plate while a player is near.

glyphs.title: Speech bubble
glyphs.about: A 13 x 9 bubble, outlined, whose tail ends 2 rows over the plate's top.

glyphs.title: Speech bubble dots
glyphs.about: The bubble's three dots on its fourth row, white, tinted to the NPC's colour.

glyphs.title: World right-click mark
glyphs.about: A 7 x 8 mouse with its right key lit, centred on the baseline for world display entities.
